purpose: Metamodel correspondence from canonical DSML4JaCaMo Ecore declarations to USE-side metamodel concepts. Project parsing, concrete binding, runtime state and execution are later layers.

resolvedDependentSources: Moise organisation XML and referenced organisational sources

semanticBoundary.inputToMapper: JaCaMo semantic model parsed from the project
semanticBoundary.rule: Mapping never relies on filename/class-name heuristics as formal semantics.

oclStage.policy: OCL profiles/constraints are applied after structural/verification projection; Norm is never translated into OCL merely because it is normative.

targetUSE.validationScope: Static metamodel compilation only; no MSystemState, object binding or operation replay.

policies.classMapping: Each EClass becomes a USE class with the same name. abstract=true is preserved.
policies.attributeMapping: Each declared EAttribute becomes a scalar USE attribute. The current baseline contains only 0..1 scalar EAttributes. The mapper copies resolved semantic values; it does not invent values for reconstruction-clipped attributes.
policies.inheritanceMapping: Each eSuperType becomes USE class inheritance without semantic normalization.

containmentReferenceMapping.firstEndMultiplicity: 0..1 because an EObject has at most one container for this containment link

nonContainmentReferenceMapping.firstEndMultiplicity: * because no eOpposite/reverse bound is declared in this reconstruction

identifierPolicy.metamodelElements: Preserve source spelling and owner-qualified identity exactly. Three USE keyword attributes use explicit reversible targetAttributeEscapes; no Core rename.
identifierPolicy.projectObjectIdentifiers: deterministically sanitize to USE identifiers; preserve original JaCaMo identifier in transformation trace
identifierPolicy.generatedConcreteArtifactClass: use resolved Java simple class name; on collision append a stable short hash of the fully-qualified name

policies.sourceExpressionPolicy: Jason expressions, rules, contexts, signal/await expressions and Moise string-valued fields remain String unless a later verified semantic parser introduces a typed representation. They are not silently parsed as OCL.
policies.constraintPolicy: Mapping establishes the USE semantic substrate. OCL constraints are maintained separately and bind to mapped USE classes/operations.

evolutionPolicy.addedEClassOrFeature: generate mapping suggestion using generic rules but mark REVIEW_REQUIRED before accepting
evolutionPolicy.removedOrRenamedElement: mark stale mapping and BLOCK; never silently retarget by name similarity
evolutionPolicy.versioning: increment mapping minor version for compatible additions; major version for semantic/breaking changes

verificationProjections.name: ConcreteArtifactTypeProjection
verificationProjections.source: Parsed JaCaMo project: concrete CArtAgO artifact implementation type referenced by the project
preconditions: type is a CArtAgO Artifact subtype or is confirmed by the parser

target.rule: Generate one concrete USE subclass of Artifact per distinct resolved artifact implementation type.

verificationProjections.trace: Keep fully-qualified Java artifact class name as transformation metadata. Do not infer a domain class from an Agent name.

metamodelContract.purpose: Expose a resolved implementation type as an Artifact subtype without changing the baseline Artifact class.
assumptions: External semantic parser supplies an implementation type with proven Artifact ancestry.
Concrete identifiers are not allocated by this metamodel contract.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No baseline information is removed. Java implementation behavior is not represented by the subtype declaration.

verificationProjections.name: ObservablePropertyStateProjection
verificationProjections.source: Parsed concrete observable property owned by a concrete Artifact instance/type
verificationProjections.structuralRepresentation: Preserve ObsProperty object/link according to R-mappings.
verificationProjections.runtime: Current observable property value materializes as !set on the concrete artifact object.
verificationProjections.fallback: If name/type cannot be resolved reliably, DO NOT invent a USE attribute; retain only the structural ObsProperty representation and emit a diagnostic.
verificationProjections.reason: Enables state invariants and operation pre/postconditions over natural artifact state.

metamodelContract.purpose: Provide a typed USE attribute concept for a resolved observable property while retaining structural ObsProperty.
assumptions: External input must supply a property name and USE-compatible type; do not use the clipped initialValue type.
Generated member name must not collide with inherited attributes or navigation roles.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: Structural identity/link is retained. Java value representation and update semantics are outside this projection.

verificationProjections.name: CArtAgOOperationProjection
verificationProjections.source: Parsed concrete CArtAgO operation owned by a concrete Artifact implementation
verificationProjections.structuralRepresentation: Preserve AbsOperation/Operation object and Artifact.operation composition according to structural mappings.

target.name: resolved operation name
target.resultType: resolved result type when meaningful, otherwise no result

verificationProjections.fallback: If owner/name/signature cannot be resolved from the JaCaMo/CArtAgO source, DO NOT guess from filenames or Agent actions; keep only structural operation representation and emit a diagnostic.
verificationProjections.oclCapability: This projection is the anchor for USE OCL preconditions and postconditions.

metamodelContract.purpose: Map a resolved artifact operation signature to the USE operation metaconcept without turning Operation EClass into EOperation.
assumptions: External input must supply owner/name and complete ordered parameter types/names, plus optional result.
Signature must be representable in USE and unique on the generated subtype; unsupported Java signatures remain unprojected.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: Structural operation object remains. Java execution, guards and effects are not encoded by the declaration.

verificationProjections.name: ExternalActionOperationConsistency
verificationProjections.target: Keep the mapped USE association from ExternalAction to AbsOperation and, when VP003 exists, add transformation trace from the AbsOperation object to its projected USE operation.
verificationProjections.purpose: Supports cross-dimensional Jason action <-> CArtAgO operation verification without collapsing Agent into Artifact.

metamodelContract.purpose: Identify the existing action-to-operation association as a future verification anchor; do not create a second association.
assumptions: Optional trace to a projected operation belongs to a later layer and requires VP003.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No structural loss; no receiver resolution or action execution is inferred.

verificationProjections.name: ObservablePropertyBeliefConsistency
verificationProjections.target: Use mapped USE association unchanged. VP002 may additionally expose the concrete state value as an artifact attribute.
verificationProjections.purpose: Supports environment percept <-> Jason belief consistency checks.

metamodelContract.purpose: Identify the existing observable-property-to-belief association without reversing its direction.
assumptions: Optional state projection is VP002; it does not replace this association.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No structural loss; correspondence does not assert percept delivery or belief synchronization.

verificationProjections.name: OrganisationalGoalAgentGoalConsistency
verificationProjections.purpose: Supports Moise organisational goal <-> Jason goal consistency checks.

metamodelContract.purpose: Identify the organisational-goal-to-agent-goal association for later verification.
assumptions: No satisfaction or achievement semantics are inferred from the link.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No structural loss; achievement/runtime semantics are outside scope.

verificationProjections.name: NormPreservation
verificationProjections.source: Norm, Nrole, NMission and their attributes
verificationProjections.target: Represent Norm as USE class/object plus associations only.
verificationProjections.forbiddenTransformation: Do not translate obligation/permission/prohibition labels into OCL constraints automatically.
verificationProjections.purpose: Keeps deontic/normative semantics distinct from OCL state/operation constraints.

metamodelContract.purpose: Keep the normative representation as ordinary class/attributes/associations, without deontic-to-OCL translation.
assumptions: Normative strings are preserved as strings; no semantic interpretation is performed.
metamodelContract.informationLoss: No structural loss; deontic interpretation is intentionally not translated.

operationReplay.when: runtime/event adapter provides a concrete projected operation invocation
operationReplay.effectMaterialization: Apply observed !set/!insert/!delete changes between enter and exit before postcondition evaluation.

runtimeMaterialization.directApiAlternative: A plugin may construct/update MModel and MSystemState directly instead of materializing .use/.cmd files, but it must obey the same mapping semantics.

contract.identityRule: Feature identity always includes declaring owner; bare feature names are not lookup keys. Inherited features resolve through their declaring owner.
contract.reverseRoleRule: Retain unique source_<feature>; for colliding reverse roles use source_<declaringOwner>_<feature>. Legacy ambiguous aliases are not valid identifiers.
contract.orderingRule: Copy EReference ordered/unique metadata; ordered=true on many-valued forward USE association ends; inverse order is unspecified.
contract.containmentRule: Map source containment to USE composition at firstEnd; per-link inverse 0..1. No runtime global-container guarantee is asserted by a metamodel declaration.
contract.valueRule: Preserve EType/default provenance. USE scalar values can be undefined; applying source defaults and distinguishing unset from effective default belong to later materialization.
contract.projectionRule: VP001-003 are typed metamodel templates with explicit external-input preconditions, not concrete target declarations. VP004-007 reuse existing structural bindings without duplicating them.
contract.compatibility: 1.1.0 adds schema/contract/projection anchors and order metadata. Eight previously ambiguous, invalid USE reverse roles are repaired; C/A/R/I IDs, source keys and forward names are unchanged. Consumers of legacy reverse strings must use the documented replacement names. Three source attribute names rejected by the USE lexer (from, Sequence) receive explicit target-only escapes; source keys remain unchanged.
